description: Create a public booking request. Does NOT require an API key, but DOES require: (1) requester identity — fullName plus at least email or phone, (2) submission context — channel and whether an agent assisted, (3) authorization.humanIntentConfirmed must be true. The booking is created as pending_confirmation — use public_booking_confirm with the returned confirmationToken to confirm. A bookingToken is also returned for future lifecycle management (cancel, reschedule). Rate-limited per IP+org. All requests are audited with semantic decision codes. Use public_service_list → public_availability_get_slots → public_booking_create → public_booking_confirm as the complete public booking flow.
name: public_booking_create
